# Pre-review list — every idea card from the sweep, unjudged

Built 2026-11-04 from workflows `wf_5b59f5db-8bc` (40 Sonnet readers), `wf_95340a7b-f40` (5 readers on the sources the gap sweeps found) and `wf_5a1d0daf-5cb` (1 reader); every reader blind to the others. 1987 raw cards from 46 readers, deduplicated by plain code (token Jaccard ≥ 0.4 on claim+quote, light stemming) into **1906 cards**, sorted newest source first. A merged card keeps the newest source as primary and lists the others under "also in". Nothing here is scored; §2 of the main document carries the scores and dispositions. Raw per-reader outputs are in `readers/`; the merge log in `dedupe-merges.json`.

Columns: card · source date · source (type, author, read/summarised) · claim · quote (≤15 words) · evidence (type: detail) · bears on · reader's landing guess · in inventory · also in.

### C0001 · 2026-11-04 · HumanLayer marketing home page
- **Source:** blog, Dex+others, read — <https://www.humanlayer.dev> (inventory: (A3) Marketing site humanlayer.dev)
- **Claim:** Six-phase QRSPI (Questions, Research, Design, Structure, Plan, Implement) puts a human checkpoint at every phase so the agent shows what it is wrong about before implementation.
- **Quote:** "Do not outsource the thinking"
- **Evidence:** marketing — Product copy; no data. Phases described in one line each.
- **Bears on:** W3, L3 · **Landing guess:** Compare to the 40-phase routine's structure; a questions-first step and a design-doc review before the plan. · **Reader:** R09 (R09-36)
